name: 3D Printer Control V1
summary: Desktop control software for 3D printers—monitor temps, run jobs, and manage settings.
description: Control your 3D printer from a clean desktop interface designed for workshop reliability. Monitor hotend/bed temperatures in real time, manage jobs, and keep key controls within reach. Ideal for day-to-day printing where stability and clarity matter.

name: Plasma Cutter Control V1
summary: Plasma cutting control suite—tune cut parameters, monitor feedback, and run jobs safely.
description: A purpose-built plasma cutting control suite focused on safe, repeatable job execution. Set and manage cut parameters, monitor key feedback signals, and keep emergency controls prominent. Built for operators who need fast setup and predictable results.

name: ECU/TCU Control System V1
summary: ECU/TCU control dashboard—live telemetry, profiles, logging, and calibration tools.
description: A powerful ECU/TCU control dashboard for live telemetry, configuration, and diagnostic workflows. Manage profiles, view sensor data in real time, and support tuning and validation tasks with structured screens. Designed as a practical interface for real-world engine/gearbox development.

name: Fridge/Freezer Control V1
summary: Smart fridge/freezer controller—setpoints, compressor control, and live monitoring.
description: A smart fridge/freezer controller interface for setpoint control and live monitoring. Track temperature, compressor state, and connectivity readings in one view. Built for compact cooling systems where stable control and quick visibility are essential.

name: Nano GSM Gate Controller V1
summary: Simple GSM gate control—open/close/stop and status via cellular network.
description: A simple GSM-based gate controller workflow for remote operation. Issue open/close/stop commands, request status, and manage basic interaction over cellular networks. Designed for straightforward installations where GSM control is the priority.

name: Solar Energy Management System V1
summary: Solar energy dashboard—track PV/load trends and system status in one view.
description: A solar energy management dashboard that brings key power metrics together at a glance. View PV, load, and trend graphs for quick system understanding and diagnostics. Designed for monitoring, decision-making, and daily energy oversight.

name: Hybrid Gate Controller V1
summary: Hybrid gate control—Wi‑Fi primary with GSM fallback, plus safety/sensor status.
description: A hybrid Wi‑Fi/GSM gate controller interface engineered for reliability and fallback scenarios. Control open/close/stop, view status indicators, and maintain visibility of comms health. Built for sites needing both modern connectivity and resilient backup control.

name: Smart Battery Charger V1
summary: Smart charger UI—charge stages, health readouts, ETA, and live monitoring.
description: A smart battery charger UI showing charge stages, key readings, and progression at a glance. Track voltage/current/temperature with clear state feedback and estimated time remaining. Designed for practical charging oversight and quick fault spotting.

name: TCU Gearbox Controller V1
summary: TCU gearbox control—driver dashboard, shift controls, telemetry and configuration.
description: A TCU gearbox controller interface focused on driver view, shift control, and system feedback. Monitor gear state and key parameters, apply configurations, and support controlled testing. Designed for real-world driveline development and validation.

name: 12CH Hybrid Alarm V1
summary: 12‑channel hybrid alarm—arming modes, triggers, status visibility, and logs.
description: A 12-channel hybrid alarm interface with clear arming modes and fast status visibility. Monitor system state, access logs, and manage operational profiles. Designed for structured security workflows and simple daily use.

name: 16CH Hybrid Alarm V1
summary: 16‑channel hybrid alarm—expanded zones, fast arming controls, and real-time status.
description: A 16-channel hybrid alarm interface for larger zone counts and expanded monitoring. Fast access to arming modes, clear state display, and improved overview for more inputs. Designed for installations requiring additional zones and clear control.
